problem: The UI and server required an alive in-range mammoth before starting an attack.

The user's 3002 server was running pre-hunting code while serving newer frontend files. One open page had no F handler; another had a disabled attack button because the legacy animal state had no phase.
changes: F, physical KeyF, 5 and the attack button initiate a forward spear swing without selecting or requiring a target.
The server resolves one nearest damageable target after 333 ms within reach, a forward 55-degree half-angle, and unobstructed line of sight. Swing cooldown is 850 ms.
Explicit nearby click targets can aim; stale, missing, remote and invalid targets do not block the swing.
The common combat handler supports hostile entries in room.enemies and animals, excluding friendly players and the village NPC. No new enemy species or spawn locations were introduced.
Attacking interrupts cooking while retaining raw meat. IME composition, text entry and modifier shortcuts do not trigger attacks.
All four existing local game ports now report combatVersion 2. The user's existing pages were refreshed at the same URLs.

restart.legacyAnimals: Moved to the new open-meadow defaults; original snapshot retained.
restart.limits: Public snapshots do not include movement paths or resource regeneration timestamps. Movement stops and regeneration timers restart. This is a one-time local upgrade wrapper, not permanent account persistence.
